myShelf.subtitle: Your favourite tools and the ones you used last will live here.
myShelf.emptyTitle: Your shelf is empty, for now
myShelf.emptyBody: Tap the heart on any tool to keep it here. Tools you open show up here too, so you can jump straight back in next time. Here are a few people start with.
myShelf.popularFunBlurb: Quick, silly and made to share. Start with one of these.

onboard.o1Title: Tools for the jobs that keep coming back.
onboard.o1Body: Shrink a photo for a form, work out your CGPA, merge a PDF. Open a tool, get it done, get on with your day.
onboard.o2Body: Small games and silly tests to play on your own or send to friends. Every result comes with a card made for your story.
onboard.o3Body: A few things that make TopperShelf easy to live with.
onboard.perk1Text: Pick a date and time and your phone alerts you, even when the app is closed.
onboard.perk2Text: Calculators and your saved tools keep working with no internet.
onboard.perk3Text: Your decks, countdowns and favourites follow you to a new phone.
onboard.notifOn: Notifications are on. You can change this any time in Settings.
onboard.notifAsk: Allow notifications for your reminders and occasional news about new tools. You can change this any time in Settings.

signin.title: One sign-in. Every tool.
signin.body: Free to use. Sign in once with Google to run any tool and keep your favourites.
signin.footer: No watermarks, no popups. File tools work on your device wherever they can.
